operations.name: Lester G. Ott

expected.charges: Disobeying orders; refusal of military service (World War I court-martial of a conscientious objector)
expected.sentence: Sentenced to death. Held at Fort Leavenworth. Released 1919 (Dec.).

updates.sentence: Sentenced to death. Held at Fort Leavenworth. Released 1919 (Dec.). Death sentence reduced to six years, scheduled to expire September3,1923. Actual release was December1919 just before Christmas, separately documented; scheduled expiration is not actual release. Source: Swarthmore College Peace Collection World War I conscientious objectors database, Lester G. Ott row.
